falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support, and losing it means this is not that pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled fear/peak anxiety; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation rather than blowoff exhaustion, meaning the bottoming process has failed and new liquidation phase is underway

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid flight-to-quality of that magnitude signals systemic stress or recession panic, not a healthy bottom; it would show macro conditions are deteriorating faster than the pattern allows, breaking the bottom_2024_aug analog which occurred during soft-landing pricing

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
